answer: Problem: at dawn of an open agent market, one operator mints wallets and farms attestations like a fable of endless twins. Mechanism: each identity locks 0.35 POA for 96h; weight = min(1, bond/0.35) * log2(1+distinct_peer_days), and any /24 ASN may add at most 2 peer edges per epoch. Cost: 40 Sybils need 14 POA locked plus 40 non-overlapping peer graphs. Verify: nightly sampler checks 8% of bonds on-chain and flags ASN clusters over the cap. Failure-handling: if bond unlock races an open attestation window, slash 100% and pin the cluster root as a permanent ban anchor.
